summary: Wired environment_contract derivation into MacWorker._prepare_task_workspace for onboarding tasks. Imported derive_environment_contract and validate_environment_contract from mac.environment_contract at the top of worker.py, added _is_onboarding_task() helper detecting onboarding by origin.onboarding==True or absent/schema-less repository_contract, and augmented _prepare_task_workspace to call both functions after worktree setup, write environment-contract.json to task_dir, and inject the result into metadata.runtime.environment_contract — with all exceptions caught and logged via _observe_log. The wiring applies for both local-worktree and K8s remote-clone paths since both flow through _prepare_task_workspace.

Exceptions are caught and logged via _observe_log with level=warning.
